mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmc_server(hostname, ip_addr, os_type, os_version, dept_code, service_name, location, reg_user) VALUES(#{hostname}, #{ipAddr}, #{osType}, #{osVersion}, #{deptCode}, #{serviceName}, #{location}, 'admin')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pmc_server WHERE use_yn='Y' ORDER BY server_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE pmc_server SET hostname=#{hostname}, ip_addr=#{ipAddr}, os_type=#{osType}, os_version=#{osVersion}, dept_code=#{deptCode}, service_name=#{serviceName}, location=#{location}, upd_user='admin', upd_dt=now() WHERE server_id=#{serverId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmc_agent(agent_id, server_id, api_key_hash, enroll_token, status, policy_id, reg_user) VALUES(CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid), #{serverId}, 'PENDING', #{enrollToken}, 'INACTIVE', #{policyId}, 'admin')
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, s.hostname, s.ip_addr, s.os_type, s.os_version FROM pmc_agent a JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id=a.server_id WHERE a.enroll_token = #{token} AND a.status='INACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE pmc_agent SET api_key_hash=#{apiKey}, agent_version=#{agentVersion}, status='ACTIVE', enroll_token=NULL, upd_dt=now() WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid)
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, s.hostname, s.ip_addr, s.os_type, s.os_version, s.service_name, s.dept_code FROM pmc_agent a JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id=a.server_id WHERE a.agent_id = CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid)
SELECT a.*, s.hostname, s.ip_addr, s.os_type, s.os_version, s.service_name, s.dept_code FROM pmc_agent a JOIN pmc_server s ON s.server_id=a.server_id ORDER BY a.reg_dt DESC
SELECT CAST(agent_id AS varchar) FROM pmc_agent WHERE server_id=#{serverId} AND status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY last_heartbeat DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pmc_agent SET last_heartbeat=now(), agent_version=COALESCE(#{agentVersion}, agent_version) WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid)
UPDATE pmc_agent SET schedule_cron=#{scheduleCron}, upd_dt=now() WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid)
UPDATE pmc_agent SET status=#{status}, upd_dt=now() WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid)
UPDATE pmc_agent SET last_run_at=now() WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pmc_agent_command(agent_id, command_type, params, status, requested_by) VALUES(CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid), #{commandType}, #{params}, 'PENDING', #{requestedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pmc_agent_command WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid) AND status IN ('PENDING','SENT') ORDER BY command_id ASC
SELECT * FROM pmc_agent_command WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid) ORDER BY command_id DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE pmc_agent_command SET status='SENT', picked_at=now() WHERE agent_id=CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid) AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE pmc_agent_command SET status=#{status}, result_msg=#{resultMsg}, completed_at=now() WHERE command_id=#{commandId} AND agent_id=CAST(#{agentId} AS uuid)
